name: Phenylephrine Hydrochloride
indications_original: Phenylephrine Hydrochloride Injection 10 mg/mL is indicated for increasing blood pressure in adults with clinically important hypotension resulting primarily from vasodilation in the settings of anesthesia and septic shock.
contraindications_original: • MUST BE DILUTED before administration. ( 2.1 ) Dosing for Perioperative Hypotension • Intravenous bolus administration: 50 mcg to 250 mcg ( 2.2 ) • Intravenous continuous infusion: 0.5 mcg/kg/minute to 1.4 mcg/kg/minute titrated to effect ( 2.2 ) Dosing for Patients with Vasodilatory Shock • Intravenous continuous infusion: 0.5 mcg/kg/minute to 6 mcg/kg/minute titrated to effect ( 2.2 )
